author: reek
body: Adversarial probe (effect rows stage 0). A def declared pure let-binds an effectful call in a plain (non-act) body. The act-union fix (CL 6494) covers act statements; a let-bound intermediate in an ordinary body may still vanish before the def-boundary subset check, because check-effect-subset extracts effects from the RESULT type only. If this compiles, declared-pure code performs Console I/O at runtime. Effect rows stage 3 must reject it with CDX2031.
